name: Harmony 300, the TV's power on delay at 10 s
description: todo-compile-300 1.5. On the 300 the TV's power on delay that is ever run is the copy inside Watch TV's own list: Watch TV toggles the KPN's power, waits 1.5 s, toggles the Panasonic television's power, then holds every later command to the television for the delay; the copy in the TV's power state list is reached by no key on this configuration, since the Power key sends the toggle code alone. The file under test has both copies at 100 tenths. Written down before the run: Volume Up for the television pressed straight after Watch TV is held until about 10 s after the television's power code. The other file, 300-1-5-delay-5s.json, is the same test at 5 s. The control step: Volume Up pressed long after goes out at once. The 300 has no screen, so the receiver is the only witness. Revised after the first 10 s run: the remote ignores every key while Watch TV is running, its delay included, and does not keep them for later, so the TV key and Volume Up pressed during the delay were both lost. So the pair is now pressed about once a second until Volume Up is heard; the first one heard comes between the delay's end and a second after it.

steps.instruction: Unplug the Harmony 300 from USB and point it at the receiver

Press Watch TV once. Then, about once a second, press TV (the top left device key) and straight after it Volume Up, and keep repeating the pair until the monitor shows the television's Volume Up, then stop
Wait fifteen seconds, then tap Volume Up once. This is the control: with the delay long run out it should go at once
